tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Keep most of the interface on canvas and surface; no full-screen saturated backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, inputs and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and nested panels that sit on a surface.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm supporting panels and empty-state fields. ink-secondary reads on it at 5.0:1.

tokens.name: sand-soft
tokens.usage: Warm tint behind Demo data labels, supporting notes and empty states.

tokens.name: mineral
tokens.usage: Inactive navigation text and icons on forest-deep (7.5:1); quiet dividers inside dark panels.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Primary action and active navigation. As text on surface, canvas or forest-soft (≥8:1). Chart series for purified water.

tokens.name: forest-deep
tokens.usage: Sidebar background, selected dark panels and the primary button's hover. Reserved: never a page background.

tokens.name: forest-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind forest text: selected rows, active tab hover.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on forest, forest-deep and danger fills (the primary and danger buttons' labels). Intentional addition: the spec's literal #FFFFFF, named.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Water-flow and water-quality visualisations only: reject series, tank fill. A mark, not text: 3.3:1 on surface meets the 3:1 floor for graphics, not for body text.

tokens.name: aqua-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind aqua chart marks and the empty part of the tank gauge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and key measurements on canvas, surface and the soft tints (≥12:1).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, labels, captions, axis labels and table headers on canvas, surface, sand and sand-soft (≥5:1). Feed series in charts (graphite).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text and non-essential metadata only. 3.65:1 on surface, 3.4:1 on canvas: below 4.5:1, so never for small text a person must read — use ink-secondary.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and table hairlines (1px). Decorative separation only: 1.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders. 1.5:1 on surface, below the 3:1 control-border floor (kept exact from the spec): pair every control with a visible label and the forest focus ring.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Normal / within-baseline state: chip text, icons and the connected dot. On success-soft 4.6:1. Always paired with a word and icon: success and danger differ by hue alone (1.04:1 between them).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text in Normal chips and success toasts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention state: chip text, icons, stale and near-capacity markers. On warning-soft 3.2:1 and surface 3.6:1 — below 4.5:1 for small text (kept exact from the spec); set chip labels at weight 600 and always with the warning icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text in Attention chips and inline alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Critical state and the danger button. On danger-soft 4.3:1 (just under 4.5:1, kept exact); on-forest white on a danger fill reads at 5.1:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text in Critical chips and error states.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational state: info alerts, Calculated and Estimated labels, metric info icons. On info-soft 4.2:1 (kept exact); on surface 4.9:1.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind info text.

tokens.name: series-feed
tokens.usage: Chart series: feed water (graphite). Intentional addition, an alias so the chart language follows the palette.

tokens.name: series-purified
tokens.usage: Chart series: purified water. Intentional addition (alias of forest).

tokens.name: series-reject
tokens.usage: Chart series: reject water. Intentional addition (alias of aqua).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus ring with 2px offset on every control; ≥8:1 on canvas and surface. Intentional addition.

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Rare: a report cover or a single hero figure. Not on dashboard pages.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page titles: Overview, Live monitoring, Test history.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section headings within a page; dialog titles.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Card titles, table group headers, alert titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Explanatory paragraphs: empty states, report summaries.
styles.sample: Monitor water quality, recovery and purifier performance.

styles.name: body-md
styles.usage: The default UI text: table cells, form fields, navigation, buttons.
styles.sample: Feed, purified and reject volumes for the selected period.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines: card context, helper text, alert meta.

styles.name: numeric-lg
styles.usage: Metric-card values. Always tabular numerals (font-feature-settings: "tnum" — bundle.css .rw-num).

styles.name: numeric-md
styles.usage: Sensor-tile values and table totals, tabular numerals.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field labels, chip and data-label text, chart axis and legend labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrows only (letter-spacing 0.06em); never ordinary navigation.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: icon-to-text optical alignment, chip inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between a value and its unit.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon to label in buttons and nav items.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls in a toolbar; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a dense row; mobile page padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card padding (20–24px in the spec); gap between page sections on tablet; card grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Desktop main-content padding (28–32px) and section gaps (24–32px).

tokens.name: space-huge
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical breathing room only; never between groups of data.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Data labels, checkbox corners, chart tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small icon buttons and tags inside tables.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs, selects, date-range control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: metric cards, sensor tiles, alert rows in a list container.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Larger chart and section panels: water balance, tank status.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips only. Never buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The only shadow a card may carry; borders do the real separation.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs and other floating overlays only.

size.note: Shell dimensions. The spec gives ranges; these are the chosen points inside them.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar (spec: 232–248px).

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar, icons only (spec: 68–76px).

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top utility bar (spec: 64–72px).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Content max-width; flexible beyond.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and selects on desktop.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum control height on mobile.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: From here: collapsible sidebar, 2-column metric cards, 6-column grid.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From here: expanded sidebar, 3–4 metric cards across, 12-column grid.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: From here: content holds its max width; extra space goes to margins.
